slides.headline: 3 good news stories to end your week
slides.subline: **A band saved, a hepatitis B first, a kidney record.** Swipe.

slides.body: The parade was delayed, so a **Texas high school band** needed more hotel nights in New York. Strangers raised [[$350,000]] in time for about **500 students** to stay.
China approved **Hibsago**, which GSK calls a first-in-class [[functional cure]] for chronic hepatitis B. Current treatments rarely achieve one, GSK says.
A **New Hampshire mother** reached [[one year]] with a gene-edited **pig kidney**, the longest known run for any patient, reports say.
Which of these made you smile most? Tell us below.
